style.vernacular: Wealthy, orderly equatorial capital of cream and white painted concrete: low-rise government and commercial blocks of 2-4 storeys, three-storey shophouse rows with covered ground-floor walkways, and Malay-Islamic civic buildings with pitched or hipped roofs and gilded or coloured domes. Water-village houses on timber and concrete stilts (Kampong Ayer) in weathered brown timber with corrugated-metal roofs. Ample lawns, planted palms and tropical broadleaf trees; clean asphalt roads.
style.ornament: Malay-Islamic motifs: gilded and coloured domes, slim minarets, trefoil and pointed arches, geometric and floral relief, calligraphy panels, songket-inspired mosaic patterns and kalat rope-like pillar motifs; pitched Malay-style roof forms with decorated gable ends on civic buildings.

sources.what: cream mosque with gold mosaic dome, 51 m minaret, marble, lagoon and barge, songket-inspired mosaics, kalat pillars
palace with golden domes and vaulted roofs reflecting Islamic and Malay influences
